design_context: Tactical Operations Command / Termux Mesh Bootstrap Companion
theme_strategy: Deep Tactical Cockpit (Dark Base with Phosphor Amber & Radar Emerald Accents, high contrast grid structure, scanned CRT feel)

typography.heading_font: Azeret Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace
typography.body_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

text_size_hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase
text_size_hierarchy.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase

typography.anti_slop_font_rule: Strictly NO Inter, NO Roboto, NO Space Grotesk. Use Azeret Mono or IBM Plex Mono for tactical telemetry headers and JetBrains Mono for body/command blocks.

colors.color_archetype: ARCHETYPE 7: ELECTRIC & NEON (Tactical Retrofuturism / Command Cockpit)
colors.contrast_rules: Text on buttons must always use #0A0D0E for high contrast. Command boxes use amber text (#FFC02A) over pitch charcoal (#080B0C). Avoid transparent backgrounds on dropdowns and modals.

layout_and_spacing.layout_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (Data-Heavy Operations Dashboard)
layout_and_spacing.border_style: 1px solid #222D33 with sharp or subtle 4px rounded edges (`rounded-sm` or `rounded-md`). Never rounded-2xl or rounded-full for cards.

command_card.structure: Header (Step ID, Command Title, Copy Button) -> Terminal Shell (Syntax Highlighted Bash, Row Numbers) -> Expected Output Collapse -> Verification Gate (Run Command + Checkbox) -> Troubleshooting Collapsible
command_card.copy_button: Includes animated state: 'COPY' -> 'COPIED!' with emerald check icon and temporary green border glow

phase_stepper.structure: Vertical or Horizontal Gated Rail (Phase 0 -> Phase 9). Locked steps are non-clickable until previous phase verification is complete. Shows progress percentage indicator [e.g. 20% VERIFIED].

verification_checkbox_gate.structure: Dedicated verification bar at bottom of each step. Requires clicking 'Execute Verification Check' or toggling 'I verified command exit code 0' before unlocking the Next Step CTA.

daemon_mesh_node_graph.structure: 12-daemon grid/map layout representing fetcherd, parserd, indexerd, vaultd, mongod, pageringd, summarizerd, coderd, sentineld, gatewayd, oracled, airgapd over NATS messaging layer with interactive status, bus topic labels, and role description modal.

bundle_download_card.structure: Phase summary card featuring file tree manifest preview (install.sh, runit unit, nats.conf, env.sample) with single-click 'BUILD & DOWNLOAD PHASE BUNDLE (.ZIP)' action button.

opsec_audit_checklist.structure: Phase 8 specific OPSEC checklist covering Android storage permissions, non-root execution, quantum crypto liboqs verification, local-first airgap boundaries, and log scrubbers.

motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Subtle border highlight shift from #222D33 to #FFB000/50 with 0.15s ease-in-out transition
motion_and_interactions.entrance_animations: Staggered fade-slide-up for command cards on phase load
motion_and_interactions.copy_feedback: Flash background of command block briefly with #10B981/10 and change copy button text
motion_and_interactions.phase_unlock_animation: Glowing pulse animation on newly unlocked phase step in the navigator
motion_and_interactions.accessibility_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion CSS query. No infinite distracting spinning animations.

image_urls.alt: Dark network terminal mesh hardware cabling

general_ui_ux_guidelines.testing_requirement: EVERY interactive element (button, input, select, checkbox, tab, step link) MUST have a unique `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case conventions.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.file_type_instruction: The project uses JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files in frontend/src. All component design instructions apply to standard React JS files.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.theme_toggle: Maintains deep dark cockpit as default, with optional high-contrast amber amber-on-black terminal mode.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.toast_notifications: Use `sonner` for toast feedback on copy actions, profile savings, and ZIP generation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the web application using clean React JS components with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI primitives.
Maintain the tactical cockpit visual style: deep slate background (#0A0D0E), amber highlights (#FFB000), monospace typography (Azeret Mono / JetBrains Mono).
Implement the 10 phases (Phase 0 through Phase 9) with step-by-step verified execution checklists for Termux Samsung S26 Ultra.

Include live interactive state: copy terminal commands, mark verification checks, track device profile in Mongo/local session, render 12-daemon mesh topology map, and generate downloadable ZIP bundles containing install scripts.
Ensure every button, input, tab, and card contains a explicit `data-testid` attribute for robust end-to-end testing.
